subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw core support `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` as a current-session-only, deferred API on successful and unlocked `after_compaction` hooks?
rationale: This is a new shared plugin API and session-lifecycle capability; the code review can assess mechanics, but automation cannot decide whether this should become a supported core plugin contract after the broader arbitrary-key proposal closed unmerged.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow hook API
options.body: Approve the after-compaction-only contract, require explicit acceptance-versus-completion documentation and successful live lifecycle proof, then merge after checks pass.

options.title: Keep reset policy internal
options.body: Do not expose a plugin API; keep session rotation inside core or owner-specific compaction policy where lifecycle success can be observed directly.

options.title: Design a broader reset contract
options.body: Pause this PR and separately define a general plugin session-management API with permissions, completion results, cooldown behavior, and compatibility guarantees.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Approve the after-compaction-only contract, require explicit acceptance-versus-completion documentation and successful live lifecycle proof, then merge after checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the public plugin hook contract and core Gateway session lifecycle rather than a mechanical implementation detail.
